beat: Pass Go. (slower, and the board's arrow: an object, drawn by the story)
rule: One text colour per card: paper on night/dark scenes, ink on light scenes and on the aplat. No letter or word in another colour. The pill and the aplat are objects, not type: the word in a pill is always ink.

safe.note: Stories: progress bar + handle on top, reply bar at the bottom. Reels: also keep right-aligned words out of x > 900 between y 1100 and 1580 (the like / comment column).

timing.note: Cues in 30 fps frames on the story's shots: 'steam+4' = 4 frames after the steam shot starts, 'scf.end-8' = 8 before it ends. Lottie (60 fps): x2, which cards.mjs does.
